source.title: In a Bind
source.description: You nearly scared me to death! I heard you coming and was convinced the dead had finally sniffed me out! All the same, you are a sight for sore eyes.  Please, I need to escape this place and find my master, Sir Dalton. May you retrieve my weapon for me? It was torn from my grip in the field outside and I was forced to flee into this barn.
source.objective: Retrieve Squire Cuthbert's sword in the field to the south and return it to him.
source.completion:
Thank you, <class>.  I can't express my gratitude for your aid.

I need but a moment to gather my wits about me. I took a terrible blow to the head out there and I'm not sure how well I can fight just yet. Oh light help me, I hope Sir Dalton is safe.
